lines.beaver_en: You got a new roommate, right? What's their personality like?
lines.en: His name is Minsu. He has a really good personality.
He's very kind-hearted. He's so kind that I'm always grateful.

lines.learner: 네, 부지런해요. 평소에 여섯 시에 일어나요.
lines.en: Yes, he's diligent. He usually gets up at six.
lines.roman: ne, bujireonhaeyo. pyeongsoe yeoseot sie ireonayo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, impressive. Is he good at studying too?
lines.learner: 네, 똑똑해요. 저한테 수학을 가르쳐 줬어요.
lines.en: Yes, he's smart. He taught me math.
lines.roman: ne, ttokttokaeyo. jeohante suhageul gareuchyeo jwosseoyo.

lines.learner: 자랑은 한 번도 들은 적이 없어요.
lines.en: I've never once heard him brag.
lines.roman: jarangeun han beondo deureun jeogi eopseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then doesn't he have any faults?
lines.learner: 입이 좀 싸요. 제 비밀을 말한 적이 있어요.
lines.en: He's a bit loose-lipped. He once told my secret.
lines.roman: ibi jom ssayo. je bimireul malhan jeogi isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, that must be a bit awkward.
lines.learner: 네, 그래서 민수도 고치고 싶어 해요.
lines.en: Yes, so Minsu wants to fix that too.
lines.roman: ne, geuraeseo minsudo gochigo sipeo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Does he have any other faults, by any chance?
lines.en: No, he isn't lazy either. He's better than me.

lines.beaver_en: What else is his personality like?
lines.en: He's quiet but cheerful. He has a pure heart.

lines.beaver: 좋은 룸메이트네요. 저도 만나 보고 싶어요.
lines.beaver_en: What a good roommate. I'd like to meet him too.
lines.beaver_roman: joeun rummeiteuneyo. jeodo manna bogo sipeoyo.
lines.learner: 그럼 이번 주말에 같이 밥 먹어요!
lines.en: Then let's eat together this weekend!
lines.roman: geureom ibeon jumare gachi bap meogeoyo!
